# Go Development Environment

This is a Go 1.21 development environment with:

- Essential Go tools and modules
- Port 8080 and 9000 exposed for web services
- Fast build times with CGO disabled
- Hot reload support

## Getting Started

1. Initialize your module:
   ```bash
   go mod init myproject
   ```

2. Add dependencies:
   ```bash
   go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin
   ```

3. Build your project:
   ```bash
   go build
   ```

4. Run your project:
   ```bash
   go run main.go
   ```

5. Run tests:
   ```bash
   go test ./...
   ```

6. Format code:
   ```bash
   go fmt ./...
   ```
